title: [review] lib.rs: Division by zero via GnssHopConfig
description: select_channel_with_gnss passes gnss_config.superframe_duration_us to sfn_from_unix_time. Since GnssHopConfig fields are public, a caller can construct a config with superframe_duration_us=0, causing a panic at runtime.
close_reason: Fixed: sfn_from_unix_time now guards against superframe_duration_us=0 by checking for zero and returning 0 early
